templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S1 Isometric drawings
templates.text: A solid is a cuboid made from [[l]] by [[w]] by [[h]] cubes. How many cubes are there?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S1 Isometric drawings
templates.text: On isometric paper a cuboid is drawn [[l]] units long, [[w]] units wide and [[h]] units high. How many cubes would it be made from, and how many of its 6 faces are visible in the drawing?
templates.answer: [[l * w * h]] cubes; 3 faces are visible (top, front and side)

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S1 Isometric drawings
templates.text: An L-shaped solid is made from a [[a]] by [[b]] by [[c]] cuboid with a [[d]] by [[b]] by [[c]] cuboid joined on its end. How many cubes are in the solid?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S1 Isometric drawings
templates.text: A model is built from [[n]] cubes of side [[s]] cm. Work out its volume and the surface area if it is a single row of cubes. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Volume [[n * s * s * s]] cm³; surface area [[2 * s * s + 4 * n * s * s]] cm²

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S2 Plans and elevations
templates.text: A cuboid is [[l]] cm long, [[w]] cm wide and [[h]] cm tall. What shape is its plan view and what are its dimensions?

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S2 Plans and elevations
templates.text: A cuboid is [[l]] cm long, [[w]] cm wide and [[h]] cm tall. Write the dimensions of its front elevation and its side elevation.
templates.answer: Front [[l]] cm by [[h]] cm; side [[w]] cm by [[h]] cm

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S2 Plans and elevations
templates.text: A cylinder has radius [[r]] cm and height [[h]] cm. Describe its plan view and its front elevation and give their areas in terms of $\pi$ and as numbers.
templates.answer: Plan: a circle, area $[[r * r]]\pi$ cm²; front: a rectangle [[2 * r]] cm by [[h]] cm, area [[2 * r * h]] cm²

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S2 Plans and elevations
templates.text: A square-based pyramid has base [[s]] cm and height [[h]] cm. Describe its plan and its front elevation, and give the area of the front elevation. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Plan: a square with its diagonals; front: a triangle with base [[s]] cm and height [[h]] cm, area [[s * h / 2]] cm²

templates.text: A solid is a hemisphere of radius [[3 * k]] cm. Work out its volume in terms of $\pi$ and its total surface area in terms of $\pi$. (4 marks)
templates.answer: Volume $[[2 * 9 * k * k * k]]\pi$ cm³; surface area $[[3 * 9 * k * k]]\pi$ cm²

templates.text: A can is a cylinder with radius [[r]] cm and height [[h]] cm. A label covers the curved surface. (a) Work out the area of the label in terms of $\pi$. (b) The top and bottom are metal. Work out the metal area. (4 marks)
templates.answer: (a) $[[2 * r * h]]\pi$ cm²  (b) $[[2 * r * r]]\pi$ cm²

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B2 Area and volume · S7 Surface area of a sphere
templates.text: A hemispherical dome has radius [[r]] m. Work out the curved surface area and the total surface area including the flat base, in terms of $\pi$. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Curved $[[2 * r * r]]\pi$ m²; total $[[3 * r * r]]\pi$ m²

templates.text: A square-based pyramid has base [[2 * a]] cm and height [[h]] cm. Work out the sloping height and the total surface area.
templates.answer: Slant height [[sqrt(a * a + h * h)|dp:2]] cm; surface area [[4 * a * a + 4 * a * sqrt(a * a + h * h)|dp:1]] cm²

templates.answer: Slant height [[5 * k]] cm; curved surface $[[15 * k * k]]\pi$ cm²
